anomalies: obsolete_loose - obsolete_strict = 0: the whole family has exactly four 'Obsolete' occurrences and all four are line-start 'Obsolete. Superseded by ...' at line 12, so the 'Obsolete for documents created in ...' / 'Obsolete and not superseded.' variant class is empty here.

The four obsolete pages (GetSymbolType, SetSymbolType, Grinding, Rotated) carry NO '## Returns' section at all, which is why they could not contribute to pointer_returns even though their signatures return values; their Returns text is genuinely absent, not merely unreported.

pointer_params_only = 0 even though IGetLeaderAtIndex does declare an 'out System.int PointCount' ref/out parameter in its '## Parameters' section - this family marks pointer-ness ONLY via the literal 'in-process, unmanaged C++' line inside '## Returns', so the ref/out-param variant that dominates some other families does not occur here.

Each of the 7 pointer pages also carries a second, different 'in-process' string - a 'See [In-process Methods](...)' documentation link on the line after the Returns block; it is capitalised and lacks the ', unmanaged C++' tail, so it is deliberately NOT counted as a pointer marker.

The 4 obsolete pages are the only pages where the '## Returns' section is missing while the member still has a value-returning signature (e.g. SetSymbolType returns System.bool), i.e. a page is not empty-shell (all 51 pages have a '**Signature**' line) yet still omits its return documentation.
No empty-shell pages: no_signature_pages = 0; every one of the 51 member .md files has a '**Signature**' line.

zero_arg_methods needed two exclusions from the raw 20 zero-paren signatures: GetSymbolType (obsolete) and IGetArrowHeadInfo (its '## Returns' is the in-process pointer line); the raw count before exclusion was 20.

The 7 properties (GOSTDefaultSymbol, GOSTNotation, Grinding, Orientation, ProfileAngle, ProfileDirection, Rotated) are counted in properties_no_paren = 7 without excluding the 2 obsolete ones (Grinding, Rotated), since criterion F imposes no exclusion - this is what makes F and E disjoint and independently countable.

_overview.md declares property_count: 7 and method_count: 44, which sums to exactly the 51 member pages actually present on disk - the directory, the overview's counts and the page set agree; no orphan or missing page was found.

Three members return an interface type without the 'System.' prefix in the signature - 'Annotation IGetAnnotation()' and 'SFSymbol IGetNext()' - so a naive 'return type must start with System.' rule would miscount them; they are still zero-arg methods and are counted as such.

Two sibling pairs are documented identically but are separate members and were counted separately: GetNext (returns System.object) vs IGetNext (returns SFSymbol), and GetAnnotation (System.object) vs IGetAnnotation (Annotation).
